kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتنازع (form VI)
# نَتَنَازَعُ (natanāzaʕu) /na.ta.naː.za.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# نُتَنَازَعُ (nutanāzaʕu) /nu.ta.naː.za.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# نَتَنَازَعَ (natanāzaʕa) /na.ta.naː.za.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# نُتَنَازَعَ (nutanāzaʕa) /nu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
